podcasts.title: Mark Solms: Consciousness Isn't in the Cortex
podcasts.note: The University of Cape Town neuropsychologist and psychoanalyst argues that consciousness starts not in the brain's outer layer (the cortex) but in raw feeling generated in the upper brainstem, pointing to children born without a cortex who still laugh and startle. Judged from the episode description.

podcasts.title: The Soul with Emile Alexandrov
podcasts.note: A philosophy professor, now a visiting scholar at Waseda University in Tokyo, traces how the idea of the soul has changed across Greek philosophy, Buddhism, Christianity, Hinduism and Jungian psychology. Judged from the video description.

podcasts.title: Parapsychology and the Media with Joe McMoneagle (4K Reboot)
podcasts.note: The former Army remote viewer (someone trained to describe distant places using only the mind) talks with Jeffrey Mishlove about working with honest skeptics versus scoffers, and about his televised remote-viewing demonstrations. This is a remastered older interview, judged from the video description.
podcasts.interest: Psychology and consciousness (remote viewing); government psychic-spy programs as background

podcasts.title: The Most Controversial Biologist Alive Breaks Down Telepathy
podcasts.note: The biologist Rupert Sheldrake on telepathy and his theory of morphic fields (the idea that nature has a kind of collective memory), plus his speculation that plasma could be a form of life and that the sun may be conscious.
podcasts.interest: Psychology and consciousness; nature of the phenomenon (the idea of intelligent plasma)

podcasts.title: Conscious Living, Conscious Dying, Part II, with Stephen Levine (1937 - 2016)
podcasts.note: An archival Thinking Allowed program from about 1994 in which the late meditation teacher Stephen Levine, who worked with the dying, argues that we should take pain into the heart rather than wall it off, and talks about using imagery in healing. Judged from the video description; the channel says it stays public for only one week.

podcasts.title: The UFO Community Has a BIG Problem Nobody Wants to Talk About | w/ Filmmaker Darcy Weir
podcasts.note: The documentary filmmaker argues that UFO celebrities, money and infighting inside the UFO world may do more to block answers than government secrecy, and describes what he says were Steven Greer's financial demands for an interview. Judged from the episode description.
podcasts.interest: Psychology of belief in the UFO world; disclosure (secondary)

podcasts.title: Æ: The Forgotten Mystic with James Tunney (4K Reboot)
podcasts.note: Irish barrister and poet James Tunney on George William Russell, the Irish poet, painter and mystic who signed his work "Æ" and described seeing luminous beings in the Irish countryside. Judged from the video description.
podcasts.interest: UFO and folklore overlaps (Irish visionary beings); psychology and consciousness

podcasts.title: The Tedesco Brothers: UFO Encounters, the Hitchhiker Effect & the FBI
podcasts.note: The Nightcrawler field researchers on their recent observations and on experiences they say follow researchers home, including bedroom orbs.

podcasts.title: There’s A Cosmic War Going On Above Your Head (Jason Jorjani Part 3)
podcasts.note: Part 3 of Jesse Michels' talks with philosopher Jason Jorjani, framed around a hidden "control system" and non-human intelligence. Title confirmed from YouTube; the content summary is unconfirmed and the views are speculative.
podcasts.interest: Control mechanism (mind control, control system); nature of the phenomenon

podcasts.title: Jacques Vallée: AI Could Contact UFOs Before We Do!
podcasts.note: Vallée on whether AI might make contact with the UFO phenomenon before humans do.

podcasts.title: Top Religious Scholar: “Aliens Aren’t What You Think!”
podcasts.note: Rice University religion scholar, Pasulka's frequent co-author, argues aliens are not what we assume.
podcasts.interest: Vallée circle (Kripal co-wrote with Vallée); consciousness

podcasts.title: “AI Is ALIEN Technology!” -Whistleblower Reveals TRUTH
podcasts.note: Quantum-computing founder and UAP experiencer on the idea that AI is tied to alien technology.

podcasts.title: U.S. Navy Scientist UNLEASHED: AI, UFOs, Sentient Plasma & TIME TRAVEL
podcasts.note: Navy scientist on AI, UFOs, possibly sentient plasma, and time travel.

podcasts.title: A Priest on UFOs: “The Church Needs to Start Paying Attention”
podcasts.note: A Welsh priest on non-human intelligence, the Bible, and why the church should pay attention.

podcasts.title: Karin Austin: John Mack, Experiencers & the Disclosure Problem | Part 2
podcasts.note: An experiencer on working with Harvard psychiatrist John Mack and what her encounters meant.

web.title: UAPCon 3 - The Intersection of UAP & Consciousness
web.note: An online conference hosted by Alan Steinfeld, with Grant Cameron, Yvonne Smith, Rebecca Hardcastle Wright and others, built on the premise that what witnesses perceive, remember and go through afterward is part of the phenomenon itself. Judged from the video description.
web.interest: Psychology and consciousness; nature of the phenomenon

web.title: Genius Physicist: We Will Create a Truly Alien Mind | Paul Davies
web.note: The cosmologist Paul Davies tells Matt Kawecki that AI, especially quantum AI, could become a truly alien kind of mind, and that an advanced alien civilization is more likely to be artificial than biological. Judged from the video description.
web.interest: AI and non-human intelligence

web.title: Nick Land and Conrad Flynn in Conversation
web.note: A three-hour conversation with the philosopher Nick Land, the former CCRU (Cybernetic Culture Research Unit) figure behind the idea of hyperstition, and the writer Conrad Flynn, who discussed Land's work on Tucker Carlson's show. Judged from the video description, which gives no topic list.
web.interest: Control mechanisms (CCRU, Nick Land, hyperstition)

web.title: Have UFOs been here all along? | Mystery Wire
web.note: George Knapp and Ron Futrell go through Jacques Vallée's ideas, including his view that the phenomenon has taken different forms throughout history, along with crash retrievals and foreign investigations. Judged from the video description.
web.interest: Vallée's circle; nature of the phenomenon

web.title: Chris Michaels Show: Digitalization of Contact and UAP, Plasma Science, Life Synchronicities
web.note: Rebecca Hardcastle Wright posts an interview in which she says psychic intelligence and contact experiences are being "digitalized" and links this to what she calls "soft mind control." Judged from the post's description, not the full video.
web.interest: Control mechanisms (mind control); AI and contact

web.title: Jacques Vallee UFO Control System: Mythology as Social Technology
web.note: Walters recaps Vallée's control-system idea: the phenomenon works like a thermostat on human belief, using absurd, high-strange events to reshape myth, and he suggests people can study the feedback loop instead of watching passively. A recap of Vallée's 1970s ideas rather than new reporting; the page also shows an April update date.
web.interest: Control mechanism (Vallée's control system); Vallée

web.title: AI or alien tech?
web.note: Laghari argues that we may be building an alien intelligence here on Earth, since AI now reasons at speeds, scales and along paths no biological brain can follow, so the real question is whether people keep enough understanding and control of it.
web.interest: AI and non-human intelligence; AI as a control question

web.title: Things That Go Beep in the Night: Agentic AI Joins the Search for Extraterrestrial Signals
web.note: Porter reports that Breakthrough Listen and the SETI Institute now let AI agents steer the Allen Telescope Array and screen its data, and frames the search as human-built AI listening for AI built by aliens. A company blog, so partly promotional.
web.interest: AI and non-human intelligence

web.title: Is UAP Storytelling Akin to Religious Myths?
web.note: The Harvard astronomer argues that UFO stories held on conviction rather than evidence work more like religion than science. He says Jay Stratton's new book uses a self-sealing logic, where any demand for hard evidence is treated as proof of a cover-up.
web.interest: Psychology of belief and myth; disclosure (secondary)

web.title: What If UFOs Are Revealing the True Nature of Reality? | Tom Campbell Meets Chris Bledsoe's Children
web.note: The physicist Tom Campbell (author of My Big TOE) tells Ryan Bledsoe and Emily Bledsoe Holloway, children of the experiencer Chris Bledsoe, that physical reality is a virtual reality made by consciousness, and that UFO encounters may be meant to widen our view of reality rather than frighten us. Judged from the video description.
web.interest: Nature of the phenomenon; psychology and consciousness

web.title: He Had a Near-Death Experience and Realized What UFOs Actually Are | Keith Thompson
web.note: The author of Angels and Aliens describes his own near-death experience and argues that UFOs, near-death experiences and myth are different masks of one underlying reality, drawing on Vallée and John Mack. Judged from the video description.
web.interest: Vallée's circle; UFO and folklore overlaps; psychology and consciousness

web.title: AI Might Be Why We Haven't Found Aliens
web.note: A documentary-style video that walks through the rise of today's AI and asks whether every civilization builds a superintelligence, and whether that is why we hear no one out there (the Fermi paradox). Judged from the video description.
web.interest: AI and non-human intelligence

web.title: UFOs & Time Machines: Are Aliens Actually Humans from the Future? | Dr. Michael Masters
web.note: The anthropologist Michael Masters discusses his idea that the beings people report may be future humans traveling back in time. Judged from the title and Masters's published argument; the description lists no details.
web.interest: Nature of the phenomenon (who the visitors might be)

web.title: The Non-Human Intelligence Coming in 2027 Isn't What You Think
web.note: Steve Lehto argues that the much-hyped "2027" date in UFO circles may turn out to be about AI, noting that former Google chief Eric Schmidt called AI "non-human intelligence," the same phrase David Grusch used. Judged from the video description.
web.interest: AI and non-human intelligence

web.title: Bottomless and Bottomless: Nick Land's Meltdown and Critique of Miserabilism
web.note: C. Derick Varn and the writer Grady open a mini-series on Nick Land with his CCRU-era essay Meltdown and his attack on Mark Fisher, and argue that the CCRU's "Human Security System" idea foreshadowed Curtis Yarvin's "Cathedral." Judged from the video description.
web.interest: Control mechanisms (CCRU, accelerationism)

web.title: Grant Cameron Interviews Gerald Pratt: UFOs, Astral Travel & Consciousness (Part 1 of 2)
web.source: The Paranormal UFO Consciousness Podcast (Grant Cameron)
web.note: Liverpool experiencer Gerald Pratt describes a lifetime of encounters that he says blur UFO contact, out-of-body travel and spirit contact, including claims of piloting a craft by mind, and treats named beings as possible "frequency masks." His claims are unconfirmed; judged from the episode description.
web.interest: Psychology and consciousness; nature of the phenomenon

web.title: Land's Xenosystems (w/ Michael Downs)
web.note: A seminar session with Michael Downs on Xenosystems, Nick Land's blog-era writing after the CCRU, offered as part of a course on theory-fiction and politics. Judged from the title and course listing; the description gives no outline.
web.interest: Control mechanisms (CCRU, Nick Land)

web.title: The Fourth State: Are We Entering an Era of Attacking Plasma Orbs?
web.note: Wright compares the dangerous-orb stories in three recent bestselling books tied to Skinwalker Ranch and asks whether the orbs are plasma, who benefits from a frightening orb narrative, and what British folklore about helpful brownies and harmful boggarts suggests about how we relate to such beings.
web.interest: Nature of the phenomenon; folklore

web.title: Is Our Government Being Influenced by Nonhuman Intelligence?
web.note: Author Peter Levenda talks about occultism, mythology, and power, and his own "Men in Black" experience, alongside government-secrecy themes. Only the paywalled preview was readable; ranked low because much of it is cover-up material.
web.interest: Secondary: government secrecy; some occult and consciousness material

web.title: The Fairy Lie That Killed: The Dark Truth About Changelings
web.note: A 43-minute folklore history of the belief that fairies swapped sick babies and adults for impostors, from 13th-century accounts to the 1895 killing of Bridget Cleary, arguing the belief explained illness and disability before modern medicine. Judged from the video description.
web.interest: UFO and folklore overlaps (changelings)
